last-month.label: Last Month
last-month.summary: September closed with Shane Da Costa AU having spent A$33,255.62 for the full month (confirmed final/settled - A$693.10, +2.1%, higher than the mid-day Sep 30 snapshot due to late attribution settling, a useful reference for how much this account typically firms up after month-end), generating 648 leads at a blended A$37.89 cpl across 4 active lead campaigns. FA | Accelerator Masterclass | Leads | ABO was the clear workhorse (555 leads, A$31.67 cpl, 53% of total spend). FA | 10k-Guarantee | Broad: Cold | Retarget | ABO and FA | Launchpad Masterclass, the two original lead campaigns, stayed fully dormant all month. The application funnel closed real volume: FA | SubmitApplication | Optin Funnel | 10k-Guarantee | TOF Audiences (renamed twice more since Sep 30) spent A$3,629.23 for 35 applications (A$103.69/app) - the account's number 2 spend line - while FA | MOF | Submit Application | VSL Funnel | Mixed Creatives closed the month unchanged from its Sep 30 snapshot at A$1,040.49 for 8 apps (A$130.06/app), confirming it went fully dormant in the final days of September. The Sep 30 naming ambiguity is now resolved: FA | Submit Application | VSL Funnel | Mixed Creatives | MOF Audiences (the third line item flagged on Sep 30) is confirmed via spend continuity to be a genuinely separate, newer test campaign - not a duplicate of the MOF campaign above - closing September at A$821.88 with zero applications attributed yet. FA | Accelerator VSL | Leads | ABO | $100 closed the month stuck at its single lead (A$1,495.30 cumulative spend, unchanged). RETARGET | VSL FUNNEL | ABO | $100 closed the month having spent A$470.31 with zero confirmed leads across its entire run - still the account's clearest pixel-audit candidate, and now dark for 4 consecutive days into October too. FA_RSMC_Purchase_ABO_Aug2026 (PUR) spent A$0.00 all month - fully dormant, still just the single Aug 25 sale, now roughly 38 days dormant. Campaign spend reconciled to the account total to the cent. Data-quality note: this settled pull's region breakdown appears to be missing Victoria and Western Australia (normally top-3 states for this account) - the same class of API gap previously logged for TerraSlate's region breakdown; every other table and total reconciles exactly, only the region table is a partial view this refresh.
